categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Changes duration and timeout calculations across the functional test framework and test HTTP interface, matching the 'Tests' label.
categories.rationale: Replaces `time.time()` with `time.monotonic()` in the test framework to eliminate potential clock jump flakiness and fix test failures under `faketime`. While not resolving an urgent CI-breaking outage, it reliably improves test signal consistency across `feature_torcontrol.py` and `interface_http.py`.
